title: Cancelling Online Orders and Order Lines — Care Guidance
content:
## The rule

A customer may cancel a whole Online Orders order, or single lines of it, only while the order is in status placed, that is within the service's cancellation window of placement or while the order is held for fraud review. Once released to the warehouse an order cannot be cancelled, and the customer is directed to refuse delivery or return it.

A line is cancelled only while the order is in status placed or processing, or together with the whole order. The order's status as shown on the order record is the authority for this condition, read for the very order the line belongs to.

Cancellations also arise without a customer request:

- lines are cancelled by the warehouse, with reason out of stock at pick, when stock cannot be found while the order is in processing; when nothing on the order could be picked and every line is cancelled, the order itself becomes cancelled;
- the whole order is cancelled with reason fraud review when its review is not cleared within the service's fraud review hold, in hours;
- the whole order is cancelled with reason payment failure when its card authorization is declined.

Nothing is captured before dispatch, so a cancellation releases authorizations and moves no money. Cancelled lines earn no points.

## Customer requests by order status

| Order status | Whole order | Single line | What the customer is told |
|---|---|---|---|
| Placed (within the cancellation window, or held for fraud review) | Can be cancelled | Can be cancelled | — |
| Processing | Cannot be cancelled | Cannot be cancelled at the customer's request | Refuse delivery or return it |
| Shipped, delivered or closed | Cannot be cancelled | Cannot be cancelled | Refuse delivery or return it |

## Cancellation reasons

| Reason on the record | Who cancels | Order status when it happens | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Customer request | Agent, at the customer's request | Placed | Whole order or single lines |
| Out of stock at pick | Warehouse | Processing | The lines that could not be picked |
| Fraud review | Agent, after a review not cleared in time | Placed | Whole order |
| Payment failure | Agent, after a declined card authorization | Placed, for a whole-order cancellation | Whole order |

## Points of judgement

- **Within the window (hypothetical).** An order placed at 09:10 Eastern Time on a service with a 30-minute window is still in status placed at 09:30; the customer's request to cancel one line of it is granted.
- **Held for fraud review (hypothetical).** An order held for fraud review remains in status placed beyond its cancellation window, so the customer may still cancel it while the hold lasts.
- **Released (hypothetical).** An order already in processing cannot be cancelled at the customer's request; the customer is directed to refuse delivery or return it.
- **Money.** Because tenders are captured only at dispatch, a cancelled order or line leaves nothing to refund: the authorization is released.
